records.query: NVIDIA 的核心技術護城河是什麼？
records.answer:
NVIDIA 的核心技術護城河在於其 CUDA 平台與廣泛的軟體堆疊、GPU 架構以及龐大的開發者生態系統，這些共同形成了難以模仿的加速運算優勢[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。其技術堆疊包含在所有 NVIDIA GPU 上運行的基礎 CUDA 開發平台，以及數百個領域特定的軟體庫、框架、演算法、SDK 與 API[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。這個深廣的軟體堆疊能加速效能並促進 NVIDIA 加速運算在 AI 模型訓練與推論、資料分析、科學運算、機器人與 3D 圖形等計算密集型工作負載上的部署[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。隨著 Blackwell 架構的推出，資料中心規模的產品實現極端共同設計，將晶片、網路、系統、軟體與演算法整體架構並最佳化，以達到最高效能與規模[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。數十萬顆 GPU 可互連運作，形成單一巨型電腦，這種架構是現代 AI 與加速運算應用開發與部署所必需的[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。GPU 擁有支援數萬個運算核心的平行處理能力，這對深度學習演算法至關重要[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。NVIDIA 採取平台策略，將硬體、系統、軟體、演算法、庫、AI 模型與訓練資料集以及服務結合，為所服務的市場創造獨特價值[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。透過統一的可編程架構，NVIDIA 能以相同底層技術支援多個多十億美元的終端市場，並使用內部或第三方開發的各種軟體堆疊[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。龐大且持續成長的開發者數量與已安裝基礎增強了其生態系統，並提升了平台對客戶的價值[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。創新是 NVIDIA 的核心，自成立以來已投資超過 767 億美元（$76.7 billion）於研發，孕育出對現代運算必不可少的發明[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。GPU 的發明於 1999 年推動了 PC 遊戲市場的成長並重新定義了電腦圖形；CUDA 在 2006 年的推出開放了 GPU 的平行處理能力給廣泛的計算密集型應用，為現代 AI 的興起鋪平了道路[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。

records.query: NVIDIA 如何用同一套底層架構同時佈局資料中心、遊戲、專業視覺化與車用市場？
records.answer:
NVIDIA 以統一的 GPU 與 CUDA 平台為基礎[ NVDA_10K_2025.html, chunk #19； NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]，透過針對資料中心、遊戲、專業視覺化與車用的專屬軟體堆疊（庫、SDK、API）[ NVDA_10K_2025.html, chunk #22； NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #24]，讓同一套硬體同時佈局四大市場[ NVDA_10K_2025.html, chunk #22； NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #24]。  

具體來說，NVIDIA 的平台涵蓋四大核心市場：資料中心、遊戲、專業視覺化與汽車[ NVDA_10K_2025.html, chunk #22； NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #24]。其架構的可程式化特性使得相同的底層技術（GPU、互連、軟體堆疊）能夠透過內部或第三方開發的多種軟體堆疊來支援數個價值數十億美元的終端市場[ NVDA_10K_2025.html, chunk #19； NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。該技術堆疊包含在所有 NVIDIA GPU 上運行的基礎 CUDA 開發平台，以及數百種針對特定領域的軟體庫、框架、演算法、SDK 與 API[ NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20； NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #24]。這些深廣的軟體堆疊能加速 AI 模型訓練與推論、資料分析、科學運算、機器人與 3D 圖形等運算密集型工作負載，並針對醫療、電信、汽車、製造等產業提供垂直優化[ NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。此外，NVLink 互連與交換技術使得數十萬顆 GPU 能被互連以形成單一巨型計算機，滿足現代 AI 與加速運算應用所需的資料中心規模架構[ NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20； NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #24]。龐大且持續成長的開發者社群與已安裝基礎進一步強化了生態系統，提升了平台對客戶的價值[ NVDA_10K_2025.html, chunk #19； NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。透過這種統一硬體與分層軟體的策略，NVIDIA 能以同一套底層架構同時佈局資料中心、遊戲、專業視覺化與車用市場。

records.query: Microsoft 如何把 Copilot 整合進 Microsoft 365 的產品策略？
records.answer:
Microsoft 透過將 Copilot 作為 AI 功能直接嵌入 Microsoft 365 的商業與消費者雲端服務，將其與 Office、Windows、Enterprise Mobility + Security 等產品結合，以提升每用戶收入、訂閱數和產品採用率，並透過投資 AI 基礎設施與廣告支出來支援其增長。  

- Microsoft 365 Commercial 被描述為一個 AI 驅動的商業與生產力解決方案平台，整合 Office、Windows、Microsoft 365 Copilot 與 Enterprise Mobility + Security，旨在幫助組織提升員工生產力。[MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #35]  
- 其增長取決於觸及新使用者、在核心產品與服務中加入 AI 工具、功能及代理場景，涵蓋溝通、協作、分析、安全、合規及其他 AI 商業生產力類別。[MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #35]  
- 在 2026 年第一季，Microsoft 365 Commercial 雲端收入增長 19%，每用戶收入的增長受到 Microsoft 365 E5 與 Microsoft 365 Copilot 的推動。[MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #68]

records.query: Amazon 在 AWS 基礎設施與 AI 領域（含與 Anthropic 的合作）的投資策略是什麼？
records.answer:
Amazon 正透過加大 AWS 基礎設施投資（伺服器、網路、資料中心折舊等）並大規模投資 Anthropic 與 OpenAI 的股權，同時提供與 AWS 晶片相關的融資安排，以強化其 AI 與雲端服務能力。[AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #79][AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #119][AMZN_10K_2024.html, chunk #97][AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #38][AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #39]

- AWS 基礎設施支出持續增加：Q2 2026 的技術與基礎設施成本增加主要來自基礎設施支出（包括折舊與攤銷）的上升。[AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #79]  
- 2025 年度亦同樣指出技術與基礎設施成本增加主要歸因於基礎設施支出（包括折舊與攤銷）的增加。[AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #119]  
- Amazon 正投資於 AWS，並投資於建置與部署創新軟體與電子裝置、全球寬帶衛星網絡以及叫車自動駕駛車輛等項目。[AMZN_10K_2024.html, chunk #97]  
- 為支援人工智慧與機器學習，Amazon 預期技術與基礎設施支出將隨著基礎設施與員工增加而上升。[AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #79]  
- AI 與機器學習的實際應用將改善使用者體驗，Amazon 正投資於 AWS 以利用這些技術進步。[AMZN_10K_2024.html, chunk #97]  
- 2026 年 3 月 31 日後，Amazon 投資約 50 億美元於 Anthropic 的非投票優先股，並修改主要提供 AWS 雲端服務的商業安排，其中包含與 AWS 晶片相關的合約義務。[AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #38]  
- 同時與 Anthropic 訂立最高不超過 200 億美元的融資安排，開始時無可提款額度，隨著 AWS 晶片交付里程碑達成，額度將開放給 Anthropic 提款；Amazon 亦擁有選擇權，可最多再投資 50 億美元參與 Anthropic 未來的股權融資。[AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #38]  
- 2026 年第二季，Amazon 投資 50 億美元於 Anthropic Series G 非投票優先股，並透過行使選擇權投資 50 億美元於 Anthropic Series H 非投票優先股，使該融資安排的剩餘可用額度減少至 150 億美元。[AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #39]  
- 在 Q2 2026 及截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止六個月內，Amazon 分別錄得約 505 億美元與 628 億美元的向上調整，計入「其他收入（支出），淨額」，以反映 Anthropic 融資的可觀察價格變動。[AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #39]  
- 2026 年第一季，Amazon 投資 150 億美元於 OpenAI 的 C 系列優先股，並簽署股權承諾書，同意最多再購買價值 350 億美元的額外 C 系列優先股。[AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #38]

records.query: Amazon 在 AWS、Prime 與電商業務上面臨哪些反壟斷或監管風險？
records.answer:
Amazon 面臨來自政府與監管機構的反壟斷與消費者保護調查，涉及其電商平台、Prime 會員服務以及 AWS 雲端業務，並可能導致高額罰款、業務限制及聲譽損害。[AMZN_10K_2024.html, chunk #80]

具體風險包括：

- 多項公開調查指控 Amazon 的店鋪經營（包括其履約網路與 Prime）以及 AWS 某些雲端服務侵犯競爭相關或消費者保護規則。[AMZN_10K_2024.html, chunk #80]；[AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #81]；[AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #124]；[AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #125]

- 監管機構正審視 Amazon 在資料收集、使用與揭露方面的做法，解釋仍在演變，導致對其隱私實務的不確定性。[AMZN_10K_2024.html, chunk #80]；[AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #81]

- 監管者與立法者越來越關注對被視為線上「門檻守衛者（online 'gatekeepers'）」的科技公司施加更多控制，透過現行法規與新法規增加合規成本並限制業務運作。[AMZN_10K_2024.html, chunk #80]；[AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #81]

- 在義大利面臨稅務及其他挑戰。[AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #124]；[AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #125]

- 自 2020 年 3 月以來，私人原告、各州檢察總長及美國聯邦貿易委員會（FTC）已在美国、加拿大與英國提起訴訟，指控 Amazon 存在價格固定、壟斷、試圖壟斷以及消費者保護與不當得利行為；部分訴訟已獲類別認證，其他則處於預認證階段。[AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #45]

- 此外，Xockets, Inc. 在 2025 年 6 月對 Amazon 及其子公司 AWS 提出專利侵權訴訟，聲稱某些版本的 AWS Nitro System 侵害多項美國專利。[AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #45]

這些調查與訴訟若不利結果，可能導致巨額罰款、民事與刑事責任、需改變業務做法、聲譽受損及成長受阻。[AMZN_10K_2024.html, chunk #80]；[AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #81]

records.query: Google 如何把 Gemini AI 整合進搜尋與其他產品生態系？
records.answer:
Google 透過將 Gemini 模型嵌入搜尋功能（如 AI Overviews、目的建置的搜尋代理人）以及將其擴展至其他產品（如 Gemini App、Google Workspace、YouTube 推薦、Google Cloud 服務等）來把 Gemini AI 整合進搜尋與其他產品生態系。  

- Gemini 3 提供增強的推理能力，支援跨產品生態系的視覺化與互動體驗，特別是 Search 與 Gemini App。[GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]  
- Google 將生成式 AI 與 Gemini 的力量嵌入產品與平台。[GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]  
- 目前有 15 款半億用戶級產品（其中七款擁有兩億用戶）都在使用 Gemini 模型。[GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]  
- 對 Google Cloud 客戶，提供 Gemini Enterprise 與 Gemini for Google Workspace 等解決方案。[GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]  
- AI Overviews 讓使用者能提出複雜問題、將概念分解為易於理解的格式，或對影片大聲提問。[GOOGL_10K_2024.html, chunk #135]  
- NotebookLM 透過摘錄來源並提供相關引用，協助使用者理解複雜資訊。[GOOGL_10K_2024.html, chunk #135]  
- Gemini App 提供圖像生成、程式碼支援與應用程式整合等新 AI 功能。[GOOGL_10K_2024.html, chunk #135]  
- Gemini for Google Workspace 協助使用者撰寫、整理、視覺化、加速工作流程並進行更豐富的會議。[GOOGL_10K_2024.html, chunk #135]  
- Google 利用 Gemini 改善 YouTube 的推薦系統。[GOOGL_10K_2024.html, chunk #135]  
- Gemini 正為全公司產品與服務提供 AI 功能；目前 Android、Chrome、Gmail、Maps、Play Store、Search 與 YouTube 這七款兩億用戶級產品皆在使用 Gemini。[GOOGL_10K_2024.html, chunk #131]  
- Google Cloud 的應用組合包含 Gemini for Google Cloud、Gemini for Google Workspace，以及專門為 Search 打造的代理人。[GOOGL_10K_2024.html, chunk #140]  
- Gemini for Google Workspace 將 AI 驅動的代理人帶入 Gmail、Docs、Sheets 等，協助使用者撰寫、整理、視覺化、加速工作流程並進行更豐富的會議。[GOOGL_10K_2024.html, chunk #140]

records.query: Google 搜尋如何演變出 AI Overviews 與 AI Mode 來回應生成式 AI 對搜尋的衝擊？
records.answer:
Google 搜尋透過引入大型語言模型（Gemini）推出 AI Overviews 與 AI Mode，以更直接、更能處理複雜問題的方式應對生成式 AI 對搜尋的衝擊。[GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132]  
大型語言模型使使用者能以更自然的語言提出查詢，並大幅提升問題類型與結果品質。[GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132]；[GOOGL_10K_2024.html, chunk #137]  
AI Overviews 讓使用者更容易向 Google 提問並獲得有用的回應。[GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132]  
AI Mode 則讓使用者能提出過去可能需要多次搜尋才能獲得答案的更細膩問題，利用 Gemini 的進階推理、思考與多模態能力。[GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132]

records.query: Meta 在 AI 與 Reality Labs 上的長期願景與投資方向是什麼？
records.answer:
Meta 的長期願景是將元宇宙打造成下一代運算平台與社交互動的未來，並構建涵蓋體驗、裝置與新技術的完整生態系統。[META_10K_2024.html, chunk #21]  
Meta 正將產品從二維螢幕延伸至增強實境、混合實境與虛擬實境等沉浸式體驗，以協助構建下一代運算平台。[META_10K_2024.html, chunk #21]  
其願景不聚焦於單一產品，而是打造體驗、裝置與新技術的整個生態系統。[META_10K_2024.html, chunk #21]  
2021 年 Meta 宣佈轉向業務與產品策略，專注於協助實現元宇宙，並將資源導向 AI、可穿戴裝置與設備的創新，以協助建構下一代介面。[META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #165]  
該項目預期將是複雜、演變且長期的，將涉及新興技術的開發、基礎設施的持續投資、以及隱私、安全與安保工作的加強，並與其他公司、開發者、合作夥伴合作。[META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #165]  
Meta 認識到自己在消費者硬體與虛擬/擴增實境技術方面經驗有限，這可能讓其他公司在競爭中佔優。[META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #165]  
研究與產品開發可能不成功，尤其當無法與元宇宙關鍵參與者建立關係或開發出能與元宇宙技術、產品、系統、網路或標準有效運作的產品時。[META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #165]  
部分消費者硬體依賴於與第三方行動平台的互通性，而這些平台未必提供與自家競爭產品同等的互通性。[META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #165]  
Reality Labs 的工作可能會分散資源與管理注意力，且其持續支援依賴於其他業務產生足夠利潤。[META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #165]  
隨著 Reality Labs 的演進，Meta 可能面臨美國及國際各種現行或新興法律與規範，包括隱私、安全、AI、競爭、內容規範、醫療裝置、關稅、出口管制、消費者保護與電子商務等領域，這些可能延誤產品開發、增加營運成本、佔用大量管理時間或對業務造成損害。[META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #165]  
Meta 將繼續增加對 AI 模型開發與訓練的投資，並預計將持續加大這方面的投入。[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #67]  
同時，Meta 也將繼續增加對新平台與技術的投資，特別是 VR、Horizon 與可穿戴裝置方面的工作。[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #67]  
這些投資，特別是 Reality Labs 的重大投資，至今僅帶來有限收入，並已降低營運邊際與盈利能力，預計負面財務影響將在可見的未來持續。[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #67]  
例如，Reality Labs 的投資已使 2025 年整體營運利潤減少約 191.9 億美元（$19.19 billion），且 Meta 預計 2026 年 Reality Labs 的營運虧損將與 2025 年相近。[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #67]  
若長期來看這些投資未能成功，Meta 的業務與財務表現將受到損害。[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #67]  
Meta 的 AI 投資亦支援產品與服務的多項舉措，例如協助內容排名系統、探索引擎、廣告商工具、新一代生成式 AI 體驗的開發，以及提升產品開發效率與生產力。[META_10K_2024.html, chunk #21]  
具體範例包括 Meta AI 助理，可在旗下應用程式、Ray‑Ban Meta AI 眼鏡以及網頁上使用。[META_10K_2024.html, chunk #21]

records.query: Meta 的廣告獲利模式與 Meta AI 在旗下 App 中扮演的角色是什麼？
records.answer:
Meta 的廣告收入主要來自於在 Family of Apps（包括 Facebook、Instagram、Messenger 等）向廣告商銷售廣告位置，並以總廣告收入除以廣告投放次數來計算每則廣告的平均價格；同時，Meta AI 是一個可在其 App、AI 眼鏡和網頁上使用的助理，旨在協助使用者學習、完成任務、創作內容並與他人連結。  

- Meta 目前幾乎全部收入來自於在 Family of Apps 上向廣告商銷售廣告位置[META_10K_2024.html, chunk #21]。  
- 廣告的平均價格計算方式為「總廣告收入除以廣告投放次數」，代表廣告主為每則廣告所支付的平均價格[META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #78]。  
- 廣告會依產品而有所不同，例如影片和 Reels 的變現方式與 Feed 或 Stories 不同[META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #78]。

records.query: Tesla 如何把自動駕駛（FSD/Autopilot）技術當作與競爭對手的核心差異化？
records.answer:
Tesla 透過其專有的 Full Self-Driving (FSD) (Supervised) 功能[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #25]，利用視覺為基礎的技術、系統與軟體訓練由自行設計的自製推論晶片加速的人工神經網路[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #25]，透過 OTA 車載軟體持續改進自動駕駛及進階駕駛輔助功能[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #25；TSLA_10K_2024.html, chunk #35]，並正在開發額外的電腦硬體以更好利用車隊收集的大量實地資料持續訓練和改進神經網路[TSLA_10K_2024.html, chunk #35]，同時在 Gigafactory Texas 部署的 Cortex 訓練叢集被視為其 AI 能力與競爭對手的差異點[TSLA_10K_2024.html, chunk #35]，且已於 2025 年 6 月推出 Robotaxi 服務[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #25]，並計畫在 2025 年開始推出 Robotaxi 業務，最終將運營完全自動駕駛的車隊[TSLA_10K_2024.html, chunk #35]，進一步將自動駕駛所學的 AI 應用於機器人領域（如正在開發的通用人形機器人 Optimus）[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #25；TSLA_10K_2024.html, chunk #35]，最終使其相信每輛出廠的 Tesla 車輛皆為自動駕駛設計，且其 AI 能力與進展使其區別於競爭對手[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #25；TSLA_10K_2024.html, chunk #35]。

[TSLA 10-K period 2025] We have planned electric vehicles to address additional vehicle markets, and will continue leveraging developments in our proprietary Full Self-Driving (“FSD”) (Supervised) features, battery cell and other technologies. For purposes of this filing, use of the term “FSD (Supervised)” includes the equivalent naming convention, “FSD (Capability)” that is used in the European, Middle East and Asia-Pacific regions. In June 2025, we launched our Robotaxi service, an autonomous ride-hailing platform that harnesses our technology and vehicles. We expect this service will open access to an expanded customer base as modes of transportation evolve, and, along with products such as FSD (Supervised) subscriptions, unlock the potential to advance a service-driven business model based on AI, software and fleet-based profits. Our Robotaxi business currently operates with Model Y vehicles but, in time, will include Cybercab, our purpose-built autonomous vehicle. Energy Generation and Storage

Energy Storage Products

Powerwall and Megapack are our lithium-ion battery energy storage products. Powerwall, which we sell and lease to customers, as well as through channel partners, is designed to store energy at homes or small commercial facilities. Megapack is an energy storage solution for commercial, industrial, utility and energy generation customers, multiple of which may be grouped together to form larger installations of gigawatt hours (“GWh”) or greater capacity. As AI infrastructure drives rapid load growth, Megapack helps to, among other things, increase utilization of existing generation and transmission capacity, resulting in a more efficient use of the electric grid. We also continue to develop software capabilities for remotely controlling and dispatching our energy storage systems across a wide range of markets and applications, including through our real-time energy control and optimization platforms for Megapack batteries (Autobidder) and distributed energy resources like Powerwall (Powerhub). Energy Generation Offerings

We sell energy generation systems directly to customers and also through channel partners. We design and manufacture certain components for our energy generation products, including solar panels and Solar Roof, which combines premium glass roof tiles with energy generation. We also purchase many components for our energy generation systems from various third-party manufacturers to provide for competitive pricing and adequate supply. Technology

Automotive

Self-Driving Development and Artificial Intelligence 

We use AI to develop real-world applications, such as autonomous driving solutions and robots. We utilize vision-based technologies, systems and software to train our artificial neural networks, which are accelerated by our own in-house, custom designed inference chips. We are also applying our artificial intelligence learnings from self-driving technology to Bots, such as Optimus, a general purpose, autonomous humanoid robot in development. Currently, we offer in our customer vehicles certain advanced driver assistance systems. Although at present, same as in the past, the driver is responsible for remaining fully engaged in the driving operation, these systems provide safety and convenience functionality that may relieve drivers of many tedious and potentially dangerous aspects of road travel much like the system that airplane pilots use, when conditions permit. As with other vehicle systems, we improve these functions in our customer vehicles through over-the-air software updates. Every Tesla vehicle delivered today is designed for autonomy, and we believe our capabilities and advancements in AI differentiate us from our competitors. Vehicle Control and Infotainment Software

The performance and safety systems of our vehicles and their battery packs utilize sophisticated control software. Control systems in our vehicles optimize performance, customize vehicle behavior, manage charging and control all infotainment functions. We develop almost all of this software, including most of the user interfaces, internally and update our vehicles’ software regularly through over-the-air updates, and work to actively improve our software security with every release. Battery and Powertrain

Our core vehicle technology competencies include powertrain engineering and manufacturing and our ability to design vehicles that utilize the unique advantages of an electric powertrain. We have designed our proprietary powertrain systems to be adaptable, efficient, reliable and cost-effective while withstanding the rigors of an automotive environment. We offer dual motor powertrain vehicles, which use two electric motors to maximize traction and performance in an all-wheel drive configuration, as well as vehicle powertrain technology featuring three electric motors for further increased performance in certain versions of Model S and Model X, Cybertruck and the Tesla Semi. We maintain extensive testing and R&D capabilities for battery cells, packs and systems, and have built an expansive body of knowledge on lithium-ion cell chemistry types and performance characteristics.

[TSLA 10-K period 2024] In order to enable a greater supply of cells for our products with higher energy density at lower costs, we have developed a new proprietary lithium-ion battery cell and improved manufacturing processes. Vehicle Control and Infotainment Software

The performance and safety systems of our vehicles and their battery packs utilize sophisticated control software. Control systems in our vehicles optimize performance, customize vehicle behavior, manage charging and control all infotainment functions. We develop almost all of this software, including most of the user interfaces, internally and update our vehicles’ software regularly through over-the-air updates. Self-Driving Development and Artificial Intelligence 

We have expertise in developing technologies, systems and software to enable self-driving vehicles using primarily vision-based technologies. Our FSD Computer runs our neural networks in our vehicles, and we are also developing additional computer hardware to better enable the massive amounts of field data captured by our vehicles to continually train and improve these neural networks for real-world performance. Currently, we offer in our vehicles certain advanced driver assist systems under our Autopilot and FSD (Supervised) options. Although at present, same as in the past, the driver is responsible for remaining fully engaged in the driving operation, our systems provide safety and convenience functionality that can relieve drivers of many tedious and potentially dangerous aspects of road travel much like the system that airplane pilots use, when conditions permit. As with other vehicle systems, we improve these functions in our vehicles over time through over-the-air software updates. In 2025, we intend to begin launching our Robotaxi business, a ride-hailing network that will eventually operate fully autonomous vehicles. We expect this business will open access to a new customer base even as modes of transportation evolve. We believe our capabilities and advancements in AI, including the deployment of Cortex, our training cluster at Gigafactory Texas, differentiates us from our competitors. We are also applying our artificial intelligence learnings from self-driving technology to the field of robotics, such as through Optimus, a robotic humanoid in development, which is controlled by the same AI system. Energy Generation and Storage

Energy Storage Products

We leverage many of the component-level technologies from our vehicles in our energy storage products. By taking a modular approach to the design of battery systems, we can optimize manufacturing capacity of our energy storage products. Additionally, our expertise in power electronics enables our battery systems to interconnect with electricity grids while providing fast-acting systems for power injection and absorption. We have also developed software to remotely control and dispatch our energy storage systems. Solar Energy Systems

We have engineered Solar Roof over numerous iterations to combine aesthetic appeal and durability with power generation. The efficiency of our solar energy products is aided by our own solar inverter, which incorporates our power electronics technologies. We designed both products to integrate with Powerwall. Design and Engineering

Automotive

We have established significant in-house capabilities in the design and test engineering of electric vehicles and their components and systems. Our team has significant experience in computer-aided design as well as durability, strength and crash test simulations, which reduces the product development time of new models. We have also achieved complex engineering feats in stamping, casting and thermal systems, and developed a method to integrate batteries directly with vehicle body structures without separate battery packs to optimize manufacturability, weight, range and cost characteristics. We are also expanding our manufacturing operations globally while taking action to localize our vehicle designs and production for particular markets, including country-specific market demands and factory optimizations for local workforces. As we increase our capabilities, particularly in the areas of automation, die-making and line-building, we are also making strides in the simulations modeling these capabilities prior to construction. Energy Generation and Storage

Our expertise in electrical, mechanical, civil and software engineering allows us to design, engineer, manufacture and install energy generating and storage products and components, including at the residential through utility scale. For example, the modular design of our Megapack utility-scale battery line is intended to significantly reduce the amount of assembly required in the field.

records.query: Tesla 在電動車市場面臨什麼樣的競爭態勢？
records.answer:
Tesla 在電動車市場面臨來自傳統車廠與新進競爭者的激烈且日益加劇的競爭壓力。[TSLA_10K_2024.html, chunk #73]  

- 許多既有與新進汽車製造商已進入或計畫進入電動車、混合動力、插電式混合動力及純電動車市場。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #59]  
- 競爭者亦在中國、歐洲等重要市場提供或規劃提供電動車，且有些已宣佈未來將專門生產電動車。[TSLA_10K_2024.html, chunk #73]  
- 特斯拉的車型必須與來自較成熟車廠的內燃機車輛競爭（例如Cybertruck與其他皮卡、Model S/X與高階轎車及SUV、Model 3/Y與小中型轎車及緊湊型SUV）。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #43]  
- 自動駕駛技術與服務的普及率若不如預期發展，也會對特斯拉的業務造成不利影響。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #59]  
- 在能源產生與儲存業務方面，特斯拉面臨其他製造商、開發商、安裝商、服務供應商以及大型公用事業的競爭。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #59]；[TSLA_10K_2024.html, chunk #73]  
- 許多競爭者擁有顯著更多或更完善的資源，可用於設計、開發、製造、分銷、推廣、銷售及支援其產品與服務。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #59]；[TSLA_10K_2024.html, chunk #73]  
- 有利於本地組裝或使用當地供應商的政府與經濟激勵措施，可能使競爭者獲得更大裨益，進而負面影響特斯拉的盈利能力。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #59]；[TSLA_10K_2024.html, chunk #73]  
- 市場對電動車特性、品質、安全、效能與成本的感知、對單次充電續航里程及充電設施的擔憂、油價波動，都可能影響特斯拉的競爭地位。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #55]；[TSLA_10K_2024.html, chunk #70]  
- 特斯拉對電池供應商的依賴度高且合格供應商數量有限，任何電池供應中斷都可能限制車輛與儲能產品的產能；此外，電池成本與大規模生產受鋰、鎳、鈷等原材料價格與供應波動影響，進而可能影響其盈餘。[TSLA_10K_2024.html, chunk #70]；[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #55]  
- 全球汽車市場目前競爭激烈，且預計未來將變得更加競爭。[TSLA_10K_2024.html, chunk #73]；[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #59]  

以上說明特斯拉在電動車領域所面臨的多方面競爭態勢，包括傳統車廠與新進者的電動車及混合動力產品、內燃機車競爭、自動駕駛技術、能源儲存業務、資源與激勵不利因素、供應鏈限制以及市場感知與宏觀經濟變數。[All cited chunks above]

In addition, decreases in the retail or wholesale prices of electricity from utilities or other renewable energy sources could make our products less attractive to customers and lead to an increased rate of customer defaults. We may experience issues with lithium-ion cells or other components manufactured at our Gigafactories, which may harm the production and profitability of our vehicle and energy storage products. Our plan to grow the volume and profitability of our vehicles and energy storage products depends on significant lithium-ion battery cell production, including by our partner Panasonic at Gigafactory Nevada. We also produce several vehicle components at our Gigafactories, such as battery modules and packs and drive units, and manufacture energy storage products. If we are unable to or otherwise do not maintain and grow our respective operations, or if we are unable to do so cost-effectively or hire and retain highly-skilled personnel there, our ability to manufacture our products profitably would be limited, which may harm our business and operating results. Finally, the high volumes of lithium-ion cells and battery modules and packs manufactured by us and by our suppliers are stored and recycled at our various facilities. Any mishandling of these products may cause disruption to the operation of such facilities. While we have implemented safety procedures related to the handling of the cells, there can be no assurance that a safety issue or fire related to the cells would not disrupt our operations. Any such disruptions or issues may harm our brand and business. We face risks associated with maintaining and expanding our international operations, including unfavorable and uncertain regulatory, political, economic, tax and labor conditions. We are subject to legal and regulatory requirements, political uncertainty and social, environmental and economic conditions in numerous jurisdictions, including markets in which we generate significant sales, over which we have little control and which are inherently unpredictable. Our operations in such jurisdictions, particularly as a company based in the U.S., with additional manufacturing operations in China and Europe, create risks relating to conforming our products to regulatory and safety requirements and charging and other electric infrastructures; organizing local operating entities; establishing, staffing and managing foreign business locations; attracting local customers; navigating foreign government taxes, regulations and permit requirements; enforceability of our contractual rights; trade restrictions, customs regulations, tariffs and price or exchange controls; and preferences in foreign nations for domestically manufactured products. For example, we monitor tax legislation changes on a global basis, including changes arising as a result of the Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development’s multi-jurisdictional plan of action to address base erosion and profit shifting. Such conditions may increase our costs, impact our ability to sell our products and require significant management attention, and may harm our business if we are unable to manage them effectively.

records.query: Tesla 的能源生成與儲能業務在公司整體策略中扮演什麼角色？
records.answer:
Tesla 的能源生成與儲能業務是公司整體策略中的重要補充，旨在利用車輛技術、提供整合的太陽能+儲能方案、支援 AI 基礎建設並多元化收入來源。  

- 特斯拉同時經營兩大業務分部：汽車與能源生成與儲能【TSLA_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2】。  
- 能源業務涉及設計、製造、安裝、銷售及租賃太陽能發電和儲能產品，並提供相關服務給住宅、商業、工業客戶及公用事業，透過官方網站、門市、畫廊以及渠道合作夥伴進行【TSLA_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2】。  
- 特斯拉的儲能產品（如 Powerwall、Megapack）利用了許多來自車輛的元件層級技術，採用模組化設計以優化製造產能；其電力電子專長使電池系統能與電力互聯並提供快速的功率注入與吸收功能【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #26】。  
- 公司開發了遠端控制與調度儲能系統的軟體，並透過 AI 平台（Powerhub 用於分散式能源資源，包括 Powerwall 啟用的虛擬電廠；Autobidder 用於 Megapack 電池）讓每款儲能產品可透過韌體更新進行優化【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #26】。  
- 在能源生成方面，特斯拉於 2025 年開始製造新型住宅改造太陽能板，並於 2026 年 1 月開始首批客戶交付；同時持續生產 Solar Roof，該產品經過多次迭代結合美觀、耐用與發電效率，並使用自製太陽能逆變器（融合電力電子技術）提升效能，設計上均可與 Powerwall 整合【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #26】。  
- 為支援清潔能源、交通及自動機器人業務，特斯拉正投資建置必要基礎設施，包括增加運算硬體以更好利用車輛收集的海量場景資料，持續訓練與改進人工神經網路以達到真實世界表現；2025 年已擴充位於得州超級工廠的 Cortex 訓練叢集，並宣布與 Samsung 合作在美國製造先進半導體用於 AI 推理與訓練；目前正在建設 Cortex 2 以進一步提升 AI 訓練運算能力；2026 年將啟動六條新產線，涵蓋車輛、機器人、能源儲存與電池製造，同時充分利用現有工廠、充電與服務中心的產能以支撐未來成長【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #26】。  
- 特斯拉的業務摘要指出，公司設計、開發、製造、租賃及銷售電動車以及能源生成與儲存系統，服務範圍涵蓋美國、中國及國際市場【TSLA_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #1】。  

這些說明顯示，能源生成與儲能業務不僅是獨立的收入來源，更透過技術共享、產品整合（太陽能+儲能+車輛）、AI 基礎建設及未來產能擴充，深度融入特斯拉的整體長期戰略。【以上所有陳述均依據上述參考資料】。

The Company’s ability to compete successfully depends heavily on ensuring the continuing and timely introduction of innovative new products, services and technologies to the marketplace. The Company designs and develops nearly the entire solution for its products, including the hardware, operating system, numerous software applications and related services. Principal competitive factors important to the Company include price, product and service features (including security features), relative price and performance, product and service quality and reliability, design innovation, a strong third-party software and accessories ecosystem, marketing and distribution capability, service and support, and corporate reputation. The Company is focused on expanding its market opportunities related to smartphones, personal computers, tablets, wearables and accessories, and services. The Company faces substantial competition in these markets from companies that have significant technical, marketing, distribution and other resources, as well as established hardware, software, and service offerings with large customer bases. In addition, some of the Company’s competitors have broader product lines, lower-priced products and a larger installed base of active devices. Competition has been particularly intense as competitors have aggressively cut prices and lowered product margins. Certain competitors have the resources, experience or cost structures to provide products at little or no profit or even at a loss. The Company’s services compete with business models that provide content to users for free and use illegitimate means to obtain third-party digital content and applications. The Company faces significant competition as competitors imitate the Company’s product features and applications within their products, or collaborate to offer integrated solutions that are more competitive than those they currently offer. Supply of Components

Although most components essential to the Company’s business are generally available from multiple sources, certain components are currently obtained from single or limited sources. The Company also competes for various components with other participants in the markets for smartphones, personal computers, tablets, wearables and accessories. Therefore, many components used by the Company, including those that are available from multiple sources, are at times subject to industry-wide shortage and significant commodity pricing fluctuations. The Company uses some custom components that are not commonly used by its competitors, and new products introduced by the Company often utilize custom components available from only one source. When a component or product uses new technologies, initial capacity constraints may exist until the suppliers’ yields have matured or their manufacturing capacities have increased. The continued availability of these components at acceptable prices, or at all, may be affected if suppliers decide to concentrate on the production of common components instead of components customized to meet the Company’s requirements. The Company has entered into agreements for the supply of many components; however, there can be no guarantee that the Company will be able to extend or renew these agreements on similar terms, or at all. Research and Development

Because the industries in which the Company competes are characterized by rapid technological advances, the Company’s ability to compete successfully depends heavily upon its ability to ensure a continual and timely flow of competitive products, services and technologies to the marketplace. The Company continues to develop new technologies to enhance existing products and services, and to expand the range of its offerings through research and development (“R&D”), licensing of intellectual property and acquisition of third-party businesses and technology. The Company currently holds a broad collection of intellectual property rights relating to certain aspects of its hardware, accessories, software and services. This includes patents, designs, copyrights, trademarks, trade secrets and other forms of intellectual property rights in the U.S. and various foreign countries. Although the Company believes the ownership of such intellectual property rights is an important factor in differentiating its business and that its success does depend in part on such ownership, the Company relies primarily on the innovative skills, technical competence and marketing abilities of its personnel. The Company regularly files patent, design, copyright and trademark applications to protect innovations arising from its research, development, design and marketing, and is currently pursuing thousands of applications around the world. Over time, the Company has accumulated a large portfolio of issued and registered intellectual property rights around the world. No single intellectual property right is solely responsible for protecting the Company’s products and services. The Company believes the duration of its intellectual property rights is adequate relative to the expected lives of its products and services. In addition to Company-owned intellectual property, many of the Company’s products and services are designed to include intellectual property owned by third parties. It may be necessary in the future to seek or renew licenses relating to various aspects of the Company’s products, processes and services. While the Company has generally been able to obtain such licenses on commercially reasonable terms in the past, there is no guarantee that such licenses could be obtained in the future on reasonable terms or at all.

records.query: Apple 的第三方開發者生態系相對於 Android、Windows 等平台的黏著度是如何建立的？
records.answer:
Apple 透過其市場地位、預期可帶來的收入增長、預期的未來產品銷售增長以及相對較低的開發成本，使開發者願意在其平台上開發軟體，從而建立第三方開發者生態系的黏著度。【AAPL_10K_2024.html, chunk #41】【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #45】  
此外，App Store 讓開發者保留大部分應用程式收入，而 Apple 只收取佣金，這種收益分成模式進一步激勵開發者留在蘋果生態系統。【AAPL_10K_2024.html, chunk #41】【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #45】  
當開發者因蘋果在智慧型手機、個人電腦和平板等市場的市場份額較小而轉向競爭平台時，蘋果設備上的應用程式可用性和品質可能受到影響，這說明開發者的選擇受到市場份額的影響。【AAPL_10K_2024.html, chunk #41】【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #45】

records.query: Microsoft More Personal Computing 部門最新一季營收表現如何？哪些因素互相抵銷？
records.answer:
Microsoft More Personal Computing 部門在截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日的最新一季營收較去年同期下降 1.79 億美元，降幅 1%。[MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #71]  
具體來看，該部門的 Windows and Devices 營收減少 1.03 億美元或 2%，Gaming 營收減少 3.80 億美元或 7%，而 Search advertising 營收則增加 3.04 億美元或 9%。[MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #71]  
因此，Windows and Devices 與 Gaming 硬體銷售的下降被 Search advertising 的成長部分抵銷，導致整體 More Personal Computing 收入僅微幅下降。[MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #63]  
此外，亦可說該部門營收「基本持平」，因為 Search advertising 的增長恰好抵銷了 Gaming 的下降。[MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #66]

records.query: Microsoft 最新一季整體營業利益成長多少？主要由哪些部門帶動？
records.answer:
Microsoft 最新一季（2026 年第 3 財政季）整體營業利益年增約 20%（約 64 億美元）【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #0】【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #63】。具體來看，該季營業利益為 383.98 億美元（$38,398 百萬），較去年同期的 320 億美元（$32,000 百萬）增加 63.98 億美元（$6,398 百萬）【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #0】，增幅約為 20%【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #63】。此成長主要由兩大部門帶動：  
- **Productivity and Business Processes**：營業利益從 173.79 億美元（$17,379 百萬）增至 209.73 億美元（$20,973 百萬），年增 21%【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #67】（亦見增加 36 億美元（$3.6 billion）或 21%【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #68】）。  
- **Intelligent Cloud**：營業利益從 110.95 億美元（$11,095 百萬）增至 137.53 億美元（$13,753 百萬），年增 24%【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #67】。  

綜上所述，Microsoft 最新一季的營業利益成長約 20%，主要受 Productivity and Business Processes 與 Intelligent Cloud 兩個分段的強勁表現推動【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #63】。

records.query: NVIDIA 最新一季資料中心（Data Center）營收成長多少？主要驅動產品是什麼？
records.answer:
NVIDIA 最新一季（2026 年 4 月結束的第一季）資料中心營收年增約 **92%**，主要受 **Blackwell 300 產品及其相關的 InfiniBand、Spectrum‑X Ethernet 與 NVLink 網路解決方案** 帶動。  

- 資料中心營收為 752.46 億美元（$75,246 百萬），較去年同期的 391.12 億美元（$39,112 百萬）增長 92%（YoY）【[NVDA_10Q_202604.html, chunk #47]】。  
- 收益成長主要由資料中心加速運算與 AI 解決方案推動，Blackwell 持續佔據系統出貨的大宗，且 Blackwell 300 產品的 ramp‑up 以及對 InfiniBand、Spectrum‑X Ethernet、NVLink 的需求是關鍵驅動力【[NVDA_10Q_202604.html, chunk #42]】、【[NVDA_10Q_202604.html, chunk #47]】。

---
⚠ 口徑說明：以上比率／成長率取自財報期間口徑（財年或單季），**不是最近十二個月（TTM）**。同一指標的兩種口徑數值可能接近但不可互換。

[NVDA 10-Q period 202504] [section: Recent Developments, Future Objectives and Challenges] On April 9, 2025, the U.S. government, or USG, informed us that it requires a license for export to China (including Hong Kong and Macau) and D:5 countries, or to companies headquartered or with an ultimate parent therein, of our H20 integrated circuits and any other circuits achieving the H20’s memory bandwidth, interconnect bandwidth, or combination thereof. As a result of these new requirements, we incurred a $4.5 billion charge in the first quarter of fiscal year 2026 associated with H20 excess inventory and purchase obligations as the demand for H20 products diminished. The $4.5 billion charge was less than what we initially anticipated as we were able to re-use certain materials. Sales of our H20 products were $4.6 billion for the first quarter of fiscal year 2026 prior to the new export licensing requirements. The H20 export licensing requirements have impacted our current revenue and will also negatively affect our future revenue. We are still evaluating our limited options to supply Data Center compute products compliant with the USG’s export control rules. The export controls applicable to China are complex and address a variety of parameters, including the total processing performance of a chip, the “performance density” of a chip, the interconnect bandwidth of a chip, and the memory bandwidth of a chip. We may be unable to create a competitive product for China’s data center market that receives approval from the USG. In that event, we would effectively be foreclosed from competing in China's data center computing/compute market, with a material and adverse impact on our business, operating results, and financial condition. 22

We believe the China AI market to be a significant opportunity and the existing and new export controls will greatly hinder our ability to address this opportunity and will continue to impact our revenue and operational results. We continue to execute Data Center compute product introductions, bringing new advanced architectures on a one-year product cadence. We expect to begin shipping samples and production units of our new Blackwell Ultra platforms in the second quarter of fiscal year 2026. Our product transitions and sophisticated system configurations may create challenges in managing supply and demand.

Edge Computing revenue for the first quarter was $6.4 billion, up 29% from a year ago and up 10% sequentially. The increases were driven by robust Blackwell workstation demand, partially offset by slower consumer PC demand that was tempered by elevated memory and systems prices. Gross margin increased from a year ago on lower inventory provisions, primarily due to the prior year's $4.5 billion charge associated with H20 excess inventory and purchase obligations. Gross margin was approximately flat sequentially as our Blackwell architecture remains the majority of our revenue. Operating expenses were up 52% from a year ago and up 12% sequentially. The increases were primarily driven by higher compensation and benefits expense due to employee growth and compensation increases, compute and infrastructure costs, and engineering development materials for new product developments. Financial Information by Business Segment and Geographic Data

Refer to Note 13 of the Notes to the Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements for disclosure regarding segment information.

[NVDA 10-Q period 202604] In August 2022, the USG announced export restrictions and export licensing requirements targeting China’s semiconductor and supercomputing industries. These restrictions impacted exports of certain chips, as well as software, hardware, equipment and technology used to develop, produce and manufacture certain chips to China (including Hong Kong and Macau) and Russia, and specifically impact our A100 and H100 integrated circuits, DGX or any other systems or boards which incorporate A100 or H100 integrated circuits. In July 2023, the USG also informed us of an additional licensing requirement for a subset of A100 and H100 products destined to certain customers and other regions, including some countries in the Middle East. In October 2023, the USG announced new and updated licensing requirements for exports to China and Country Groups D:1, D:4, and D:5 (including but not limited to, Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, and Vietnam, but excluding Israel) of our products exceeding certain performance thresholds, including, but not limited to, the A100, A800, H100, H800, L4, L40, L40S RTX 4090, GB200 NVL72, and B200. The licensing requirements also apply to the export of products exceeding certain performance thresholds to a party headquartered in, or with an ultimate parent headquartered in, Country Group D5, including China. In April 2025, the USG informed us that it requires a license for export to China (including Hong Kong and Macau) and D:5 countries, or to companies headquartered or with an ultimate parent therein, of our H20 integrated circuits and any other circuits achieving the H20’s memory bandwidth, interconnect bandwidth, or combination thereof. As a result of these requirements, we incurred a $4.5 billion charge in the first quarter of fiscal year 2026 associated with H20 for excess inventory and purchase obligations, as the demand for H20 products diminished. Beginning in August 2025, the USG granted licenses that would allow us to ship certain H20 products to certain China-based customers. USG officials expressed an expectation that the USG will receive 15% or more of the revenue generated from licensed sales of our products, but the USG did not publish a regulation codifying such requirement. Beginning in February 2026, the USG granted licenses that would allow us to ship small amounts of H200 products to specific China-based customers. To date, we have not generated any revenue under the H200 licensing program, and do not yet know whether any imports will be allowed into China. The license requires that the H200s go through an inspection process in the United States prior to any shipment to the customer. As a result, any H200 shipped under the new licensing program will be subject to a 25% tariff upon importation into the United States. In the event that we are able to sell licensed products into the China market, we may not be able to pass along all or any of the tariff to our customers, and may be subject to litigation, increased costs, and a harmed competitive position. The export controls applicable to China are complex and address a variety of parameters, including the total processing performance of a chip, the “performance density” of a chip, the interconnect bandwidth of a chip, and the memory bandwidth of a chip. Under the current rules and geopolitical landscape, we are unable to create and deliver a competitive product for China’s data center market that receives approval from both the USG and the Chinese government. As of the end of the first quarter of fiscal year 2027, while we were able to ship uncontrolled products to China, such as gaming and workstation GPUs, we were effectively foreclosed from competing in China's data center computing/compute market, and our effective foreclosure from the China market helped our competitors build larger developer and customer ecosystems to challenge us worldwide. Unless we are able to return with a data center system that meets the approval of both the USG and the Chinese government, our lost opportunity and the benefit to our competitors will have a material and adverse impact on our business, operating results, and financial condition.

[NVDA 10-Q period 202604] Certain direct customers may use either internal resources or third-party system integrators to complete their build. We refer to indirect customers as those who purchase products through our direct customers; indirect customers include CSPs, AI Clouds, AI model makers, enterprises, and public sector entities. Our revenue is concentrated among a limited number of direct and indirect customers and this trend may continue. For the first quarter of fiscal year 2027, three direct customers represented 21%, 17%, and 16% of total revenue, all of which was primarily attributable to the Compute & Networking segment. Sales and Marketing

Historically, we have been able to achieve sales without relying on traditional advertising and at relatively low marketing costs. We continue to monitor our public narrative and brand, and tailor our marketing efforts accordingly, including through investments in customer education and advertising as necessary. Automotive

Direct Sales

Our vehicle sales channels currently include our website and a global network of company-owned stores. In some jurisdictions, we also have galleries to educate and inform customers about our products, but such locations do not transact in the sale of vehicles. We believe this infrastructure enables us to better control costs of inventory, manage warranty service and pricing, educate consumers about electric vehicles, make our vehicles more affordable, maintain and strengthen the Tesla brand and obtain rapid customer feedback. We reevaluate our sales strategy both globally and at a location-by-location level from time to time to optimize our sales channels. However, sales of vehicles in the automobile industry tend to be cyclical in many markets, which may expose us to volatility from time to time. Used Vehicle Sales

Our used vehicle business supports new vehicle sales by integrating the trade-in of a customer’s existing Tesla or non-Tesla vehicle with the sale of a new Tesla vehicle. The Tesla and non-Tesla vehicles we acquire as trade-ins, along with vehicles returned upon lease-end are subsequently remarketed, either directly by us or through third parties. Public Charging

We have a growing global network of Tesla Superchargers, which are our industrial-grade, high-speed vehicle chargers. Use of the Supercharger network either requires payment of a fee or is free under certain sales programs. As our vehicles are capable of being updated remotely over-the-air, our customers may purchase additional paid options and features through the Tesla app or through the in-vehicle user interface, which also allows us to offer certain options and features on a subscription basis. [NVDA 10-K period 2026] We work with industry leaders to help build or transform their applications and data center infrastructure. Some of our direct customers include original equipment manufacturers, or OEMs, original device manufacturers, or 

ODMs, system integrators and distributors which we partner with to help bring our products to market. We also have partnerships in automotive, healthcare, financial services, manufacturing, retail, and technology among others, to accelerate the adoption of AI. At the foundation of the NVIDIA accelerated computing platform are our GPUs, which excel at parallel workloads such as the training and inferencing of neural networks. These Data Center systems are extreme co-designed with the GPU, CPU, NVLink switch, DPU, NIC, and scale-out networking along with software stacks and algorithms to deliver data center-scale computing solutions. While our approach starts with powerful chips, what makes it a full-stack computing platform is our large body of software, including the CUDA development platform, the CUDA-X collection of acceleration libraries, AI models and training data sets, APIs, SDKs, and domain-specific application frameworks. In addition to software delivered to customers as an integral part of our data center computing and networking platform, we offer paid licenses to NVIDIA AI Enterprise, a comprehensive suite of enterprise-grade AI software and NVIDIA vGPU software for graphics-rich virtual desktops and workstations. In fiscal year 2025, we launched the NVIDIA Blackwell architecture, a full set of data center scale infrastructure that includes GPUs, CPUs, DPUs, interconnects, switch chips and systems, and networking adapters. Blackwell excels at processing cutting edge generative AI and accelerated computing workloads with market leading performance and efficiency. Offered in a number of configurations, for customers across industries and a diverse set of AI and accelerated computing use cases. In fiscal year 2026, we unveiled the NVIDIA Rubin platform, which is expected to commence production shipments in the second half of fiscal year 2027. Built for agentic AI and reasoning, it excels at processing multi-step problem-solving and massive long-context workflows, delivering up to a 10x reduction in cost per token compared to Blackwell.

[NVDA 10-K period 2026] NVIDIA pioneered accelerated computing to help solve the most challenging computational problems. NVIDIA is now a data center scale AI infrastructure company reshaping all industries. Our technology stack includes the foundational NVIDIA CUDA development platform that runs on all NVIDIA GPUs, as well as hundreds of domain-specific software libraries, frameworks, algorithms, software development kits, or SDKs, and application programming interfaces, or APIs. records.query: 為什麼大家做 AI 都要靠 NVIDIA 的技術，別家學不來？
records.answer:
大家依賴 NVIDIA 做 AI 主要是因為它提供了從晶片、互連、系統到軟體的完整全棧平台，並擁有超過 750 萬名開發者的龐大生態系統，這些優勢難以被競爭對手快速複製。[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28][NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28]

NVIDIA 的全棧平台包括 GPU、CPU、DPU 等運算單元、互連、系統與軟體，能提供端到端的 AI 訓練與推論解決方案。[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28][NVDA_10K_2025.html, chunk #27]

其資料中心規模的產品採用極致共設計（extreme co‑design），將晶片、互連、系統、軟體與演算法整體架構與最佳化，使得數十萬顆 GPU 能互連成單一巨型電腦。[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]

GPU 內含數萬個運算核心，平行處理能力是深度學習演算法的基礎。[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20][NVDA_10K_2025.html, chunk #19]

CUDA 平台與數百種領域特定的程式庫、框架、演算法、SDK 與 API 構成深闊的軟體堆疊，顯著加速 AI 模型訓練、推論、資料分析等工作負載。[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20][NVDA_10K_2025.html, chunk #19]

NVIDIA 採用平台策略，將硬體、系統、軟體、演算法、庫、AI 模型與訓練資料以及服務結合，透過統一的可程式化架構支援多個數十億美元規模的終端市場，僅需更換由內部或第三方開發的軟體堆疊。[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20][NVDA_10K_2025.html, chunk #19]

不斷成長的開發者與已安裝基礎設施強化了生態系統，提升了平台對客戶的價值。[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20][NVDA_10K_2025.html, chunk #19]

records.query: 微軟是怎麼把 AI 塞進 Office 那些軟體裡的？
records.answer:
微軟透過將 AI 與環境智慧整合到 Microsoft 365 Copilot 與代理人中，將 AI 嵌入 Office 軟體以提升生產力與洞察力。[MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #33][MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #32]  

具體而言，微軟應用 AI 和環境智慧來驅動洞察、革命化多種工作與業務流程，並透過 Microsoft 365 Copilot 與代理人提供實質的生產力提升。[MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #33][MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #32]  

此外，微軟提供統一的智慧層級（unified intelligence layer）用於企業 AI，使 AI 能夠基於組織資料的持續演進理解來運作。[MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #33][MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #32]  

為協助客戶掌握這些 AI 能力，微軟透過技能提升計畫、 initiatives、補助金以及 LinkedIn 學習路徑，提供生成式 AI 的訓練與更廣泛的數位學習資源。[MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #33][MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #32]  

最後，微軟利用 Windows 平台來帶動雲端業務，並提升使用者對 Microsoft Edge、Bing、Copilot、Microsoft Teams、Microsoft 365 Consumer、Xbox Game Pass 等服務的參與度，間接支援 AI 在 Office 產品中的應用與推廣。[MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #33][MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #32]

records.query: 亞馬遜最近在 AI 這塊砸錢做了什麼？跟哪家 AI 公司搭上線？
records.answer:
亞馬遜最近在 AI 領域的主要動作是對 OpenAI 進行大規模的 Series C 優先股投資，並與其達成 AWS 雲端服務合作以及讓 OpenAI 模型在 AWS 平台上提供的協議；合作的 AI 公司是 OpenAI（同時也持有 Anthropic 的非投票優先股）【AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #40】。  

具體來說，亞馬遜在 Q1 2026 初次投資了 **$15.0 億美元** 取得 OpenAI 的 Series C 優先股，並簽署股權承諾書，同意再購買總價 **$35.0 億美元** 的額外 Series C 優先股（承諾金額）【AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #40】。隨後在 Q2 2026，亞馬遜已將承諾金額中的 **137 億美元（$13.7 billion）** 投資於該 Series C 優先股，使得截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日的累計投資達到 **287 億美元（$28.7 billion）**（即 $15.0 億 + 137 億美元（$13.7 billion））【AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #40】。該 287 億美元（$28.7 billion）的投資已記錄在合併資產負債表上，而未承諾的剩餘金額則被列為私人公司股權投資（非權益法）的一部分，未來價格變動或減值將以 Level 3 公平價值計量於「其他收入（支出），淨額」中確認【AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #40】。2026 年 6 月 30 日之後，亞馬遜又投資了承諾金額的剩餘 **213 億美元（$21.3 billion）** 購買 OpenAI 的 Series C 優先股，因此對 OpenAI 的 Series C 優先股總投資約為 **$50.0 億美元**【AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #40】。  

除了投資，亞馬遜與 OpenAI 在 Q1 2026 達成兩項協議：(i) 商業安排，主要為提供 AWS 雲端服務（包括使用與表現 AWS 晶片）；(ii) 聯合合作協議，讓某些使用 OpenAI 模型的服務在亞馬遜和 AWS 上提供【AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #40】。  

此外，亞馬遜的私人公司股權投資還包括持有 **Anthropic** 的非投票優先股；截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日和 2026 年 6 月 30 日，該類投資（主要涉及 Anthropic 非投票優先股及 OpenAI 優先股）的賬面價值分別為 **162 億美元（$16.2 billion）** 和 **1,223 億美元（$122.3 billion）**，同樣將未來價格變動或減值以 Level 3 公平價值計量於「其他收入（支出），淨額」中確認【AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #40】。  

亞馬遜亦表示預計將繼續在 AI 上進行額外投資，這些因素預計將持續影響其 2026 年第三季（Q3 2026）的營運結果【AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #73】。

records.query: Meta 搞的那些 VR 眼鏡跟 AI，到底想往哪個方向發展？
records.answer:
Meta 正利用 VR 眼鏡與 AI 技術，朝著建構下一代運算平台（即所謂的 metaverse）以及打造結合擴增實境、人工智慧與穿戴式裝置的未來社交體驗方向發展【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】【META_10K_2024.html, chunk #24】。

- Meta 的 VR 產品線包括 Meta Quest 裝置以及透過 Meta Horizon Store 提供的軟體與內容，讓使用者能進行社交互動、遊戲、健身、娛樂等體驗【META_10K_2024.html, chunk #24】。  
- 為提升 VR 的接受度，Meta 在 Quest 裝置上引入了 passthrough（混合實境）功能，讓使用者在仍能感知實體世界的同時獲得沉浸式體驗【META_10K_2024.html, chunk #24】【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】。  
- 穿戴式裝置方面，Meta 推出了具備 Meta AI 的 Ray‑Ban Meta 與 Oakley Meta 智慧眼鏡，支援免手操作互動【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】。  
- 2024 年 Meta 發表了 Orion 原型機，這是一對真正的 AR 眼鏡，擁有業界領先的視野與眼鏡形狀，可將內容疊加於實體世界【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】。  
- 2025 年 Meta 推出 Meta Ray‑Ban Display，將 AI 眼鏡與鏡片內建的顯示器結合，並配備 Meta Neural Band（腕部穿戴裝置），利用肌電圖（electromyography）讓使用者透過神經肌肉訊號控制眼鏡【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】。  
- Meta 同時投資於利用肌電圖的神經介面研究，讓人們能以神經肌肉訊號操控裝置【META_10K_2024.html, chunk #24】。  
- 在 AI 方面，Meta AI 是一個可跨應用程式、獨立應用程式、AI 眼鏡及網頁使用的助理，旨在協助使用者學習、完成任務、創作內容與連結他人【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】。  
- Meta 的 AI 投資支援內容排名系統、發現引擎（推薦相關內容）、廣告商工具、生成式 AI 體驗，以及提升產品開發效率的工具【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】。  
- Meta 正致力於開發下一代 AI 模型，並朝著建構「超智慧」（超越人類智慧的 AI）的願景前進【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】。  
- Meta 的總體願景是建構人類未來的連結方式，將產品從 2D 螢幕延伸至沉浸式的擴增與虛擬實境體驗，以協助打造下一代運算平台；而 metaverse 被視為社交技術的下一個演化階段【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #165】【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #56】。  
- 2021 年 Meta 宣佈戰略轉移，專注於透過 AI、穿戴式裝置與裝置創新來實現 metaverse，並預計這將是一個複雜、持續演變且長期的計畫，涉及新興技術開發、基礎設施投資、隱私／安全／安全工作以及與其他公司、開發者、夥伴的合作【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #165】【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #56】。  
- Meta 認識到 metaverse 的發展不一定如預期，市場接受度具有不確定性，因此會定期檢視產品路線圖並根據技術挑戰、市場環境及產品構想的演變作出重大調整【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #165】【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #56】。  
- 由於 Meta 在消費者硬體與 VR/AR 方面的經驗仍然有限，可能使其他公司在競爭中佔得優勢【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #165】【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #56】。  
- Reality Labs 的投資可能會佔用資源與管理注意力，影響其他業務領域，而其能否持續取決於 Meta 其他業務所產生的足夠利潤【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #165】【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #56】。  
- 隨著 Reality Labs 的演進，Meta 可能面臨美國及國內外各種現行或新法規的影響，包括隱私、安全、AI、競爭、內容管控、醫療裝置、關稅、出口管制、消費者保護與電子商務等領域，這些法規可能延遲或阻礙產品開發、增加營運成本並需大量管理時間與注意力【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #165】【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #56】。  

以上即為參考資料中所描述的 Meta 在 VR 眼鏡與 AI 方面的發展方向與相關考量。

Reality Labs Products

Many of our Reality Labs investments are directed toward long-term, cutting edge research and development for products that are not on the market today and may only be fully realized in the next decade. This includes exploring new technologies such as neural interfaces using electromyography, which lets people control their devices using neuromuscular signals, as well as innovations in AI and hardware to help build next-generation interfaces. To drive greater adoption and acceptance of VR we have introduced MR capabilities, which allow users to experience the immersion and presence of VR while still being grounded in the physical world, through our Meta Quest devices. It does this with an industry-leading field of view and in glasses form factor for comfortable wear. In general, while all of these investments are part of our long-term initiative to help build the next computing platform, our metaverse efforts also include notable shorter-term projects developing specific products and services to go to market, whereas our wearables efforts are primarily directed toward longer-term research and development projects. Overview

Our mission is to build the future of human connection and the technology that makes it possible. Our products enable people to connect and share through mobile devices, personal computers, virtual reality (VR) headsets, and AI glasses. We are innovating in artificial intelligence (AI) technologies to build transformative experiences and capabilities across our Family of Apps and new platforms, and to advance our vision to deliver personal superintelligence for everyone. We build technology that helps people connect and share, find and build communities, and grow businesses. We also help people discover and learn about what is going on in the world around them, enable people to share their experiences, ideas, photos, videos, and other content with audiences ranging from their closest family members and friends to the public at large, and stay connected everywhere by accessing our products. Meta is moving our offerings beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next computing platform. Our vision does not center on any single product, but rather an entire ecosystem of experiences, devices, and new technologies powered by AI. While the metaverse is in the very early stages of its development, we believe it will become the next computing platform and the future of social interaction. Across our work, we are innovating to build new experiences that help make our platform more social, useful, and immersive. Our AI investments support initiatives across our products and services, helping power the systems that rank content in our apps, our discovery engine that recommends relevant content, the tools advertisers use to reach customers, the development of new generative AI experiences, and the tools that make our product development more efficient and productive. We are also working to develop the next generation of AI models and advance our vision to build superintelligence, which we define as AI that surpasses human intelligence. Although it is inherently difficult to predict when superintelligence may be achieved, we are investing now because we believe this has the potential to begin a new era of individual empowerment, where people can direct superintelligence towards what they value in their own lives. records.query: 特斯拉的自動駕駛跟別家車廠比，厲害在哪裡？
records.answer:
特斯拉的自動駕駛之所以被視為領先，在於其將每輛車設計為自動駕駛平台，並依賴自家研發的AI視覺系統與專用晶片，透過隨時更新的軟體持續提升功能，因而相信這些能力能讓它區隔於競爭對手。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #25]

特斯拉利用人工智慧開發自動駕駛等實際應用，並採用視覺技術、系統與軟體來訓練人工神經網路。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #25] 這些神經網路由特斯拉自行設計的自訂推論晶片加速運算。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #25] 此外，特斯拉將自動駕駛所學的AI知識應用於機器人研發，例如Optimus。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #25] 其進階駕駛輔助系統能提供安全與便利功能，類似飛行員使用的系統，可減輕駕駛者許多繁瑣且潛在危險的駕駛負擔。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #25] 特斯拉還透過無線網路（over‑the‑air）軟體更新，持續改進車輛中的這些功能。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #25] 基於以上技術與持續改進的能力，特斯拉相信其在AI與自動駕駛方面的進展能使其區別於競爭對手。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #25]

[TSLA 10-K period 2025] We have planned electric vehicles to address additional vehicle markets, and will continue leveraging developments in our proprietary Full Self-Driving (“FSD”) (Supervised) features, battery cell and other technologies. In June 2025, we launched our Robotaxi service, an autonomous ride-hailing platform that harnesses our technology and vehicles. We expect this service will open access to an expanded customer base as modes of transportation evolve, and, along with products such as FSD (Supervised) subscriptions, unlock the potential to advance a service-driven business model based on AI, software and fleet-based profits. Our Robotaxi business currently operates with Model Y vehicles but, in time, will include Cybercab, our purpose-built autonomous vehicle. Energy Generation and Storage

Energy Storage Products

Powerwall and Megapack are our lithium-ion battery energy storage products. Powerwall, which we sell and lease to customers, as well as through channel partners, is designed to store energy at homes or small commercial facilities. Megapack is an energy storage solution for commercial, industrial, utility and energy generation customers, multiple of which may be grouped together to form larger installations of gigawatt hours (“GWh”) or greater capacity. As AI infrastructure drives rapid load growth, Megapack helps to, among other things, increase utilization of existing generation and transmission capacity, resulting in a more efficient use of the electric grid. We also continue to develop software capabilities for remotely controlling and dispatching our energy storage systems across a wide range of markets and applications, including through our real-time energy control and optimization platforms for Megapack batteries (Autobidder) and distributed energy resources like Powerwall (Powerhub). Energy Generation Offerings

We sell energy generation systems directly to customers and also through channel partners. We design and manufacture certain components for our energy generation products, including solar panels and Solar Roof, which combines premium glass roof tiles with energy generation. We also purchase many components for our energy generation systems from various third-party manufacturers to provide for competitive pricing and adequate supply. Technology

Automotive

Self-Driving Development and Artificial Intelligence 

We use AI to develop real-world applications, such as autonomous driving solutions and robots. We utilize vision-based technologies, systems and software to train our artificial neural networks, which are accelerated by our own in-house, custom designed inference chips. We are also applying our artificial intelligence learnings from self-driving technology to Bots, such as Optimus, a general purpose, autonomous humanoid robot in development. Currently, we offer in our customer vehicles certain advanced driver assistance systems. Although at present, same as in the past, the driver is responsible for remaining fully engaged in the driving operation, these systems provide safety and convenience functionality that may relieve drivers of many tedious and potentially dangerous aspects of road travel much like the system that airplane pilots use, when conditions permit. As with other vehicle systems, we improve these functions in our customer vehicles through over-the-air software updates. Every Tesla vehicle delivered today is designed for autonomy, and we believe our capabilities and advancements in AI differentiate us from our competitors. Vehicle Control and Infotainment Software

The performance and safety systems of our vehicles and their battery packs utilize sophisticated control software. Control systems in our vehicles optimize performance, customize vehicle behavior, manage charging and control all infotainment functions. We develop almost all of this software, including most of the user interfaces, internally and update our vehicles’ software regularly through over-the-air updates, and work to actively improve our software security with every release. Battery and Powertrain

Our core vehicle technology competencies include powertrain engineering and manufacturing and our ability to design vehicles that utilize the unique advantages of an electric powertrain. We have designed our proprietary powertrain systems to be adaptable, efficient, reliable and cost-effective while withstanding the rigors of an automotive environment. We offer dual motor powertrain vehicles, which use two electric motors to maximize traction and performance in an all-wheel drive configuration, as well as vehicle powertrain technology featuring three electric motors for further increased performance in certain versions of Model S and Model X, Cybertruck and the Tesla Semi. We maintain extensive testing and R&D capabilities for battery cells, packs and systems, and have built an expansive body of knowledge on lithium-ion cell chemistry types and performance characteristics.

[TSLA 10-K period 2025] If the uptake rate for autonomous driving solutions does not develop as we expect, our business, prospects, financial condition and operating results may be harmed. A significant and growing number of established and new automobile manufacturers, as well as other companies, have entered, or are reported to have plans to enter, the market for electric and other alternative fuel vehicles, including hybrid, plug-in hybrid and fully electric vehicles, as well as the market for self-driving technology and services and other vehicle applications and software platforms. Many of our competitors have significantly more or better-established resources than we do to devote to the design, development, manufacturing, distribution, promotion, sale and support of their products and services, and may achieve additional cost efficiencies owing to location and economic environments. Increased competition could result in our lower vehicle unit sales, price reductions, revenue shortfalls, loss of customers and loss of market share, which may harm our business, financial condition and operating results. Regulation of Autonomous Vehicles and Autonomous Vehicle Ride-Hailing 

Generally, laws pertaining to autonomous vehicles are evolving globally, and in some cases may impose restrictions on our features or vehicle designs. In the U.S., while NHTSA has updated certain FMVSS to account for autonomous vehicle design, other FMVSS and regulations do not currently account for autonomous vehicle design and additional rulemaking by NHTSA may occur. These requirements are in addition to manufacturer reporting obligations, and NHTSA retains the authority to investigate and/or take action on the safety or compliance of any vehicle, equipment or features operating on public roads. Additionally, certain U.S. states and cities have legal restrictions on, or are considering additional regulation of, the testing, commercial operation, marketing, registration and licensure of autonomous vehicles, including commercial ride-hailing with a fleet of autonomous vehicles, and many other states and cities are considering them. This regulatory patchwork increases the legal complexity with respect to autonomous vehicles and an autonomous vehicle ride-hailing business in the U.S. In Europe and other countries that follow the regulations of the United Nations Economic Commission for Europe (“ECE countries”), some requirements restrict the design of both advanced driver-assistance and autonomous systems, which can compromise or prevent their use entirely. On a European Union level, additional layers of regulatory frameworks may impose further obligations in areas such as risk management, data-governance, trainings, technical documentation. Meanwhile, on a national level, the enforcement of certain applicable regulations may vary. Proposed national laws may further hinder or complicate the path of both advanced driver-assistance and autonomous vehicle systems, including the timeline for introducing autonomous vehicles for sale and use in ECE countries. When coupled together, the layers of regulation as well as the fragmentation across each ECE country may hinder or complicate the path and timeline to introducing autonomous vehicles and an autonomous vehicle ride-hailing business in them. Other key markets, including China, continue to develop and establish driver-assistance and autonomous vehicle regulations. Any implemented regulations may differ materially from U.S.

Competing products typically include internal combustion vehicles from more established automobile manufacturers; however, many established and new automobile manufacturers have entered or have announced plans to enter the market for electric and other alternative fuel vehicles. Overall, we believe these announcements and vehicle introductions promote the development of the electric vehicle market by highlighting the attractiveness of electric vehicles relative to internal combustion vehicles. Therefore, we provide an AI-based hardware and software solution, designed and implemented from the ground up based on automotive safety standards, for the AV and EV market under the DRIVE brand, which we are bringing to market through our partnerships across the transportation industry including with automotive OEMs, mobility service providers, robotaxis, tier-1 suppliers, and start-ups. Our AV solution also includes the GPU-based hardware required to train the neural networks before their in-vehicle deployment, as well as to re-simulate their operation prior to any over-the-air software updates. We believe our comprehensive, top-to-bottom and end-to-end approach will enable the transportation industry to solve the complex problems arising from the shift to autonomous driving. 7


Leveraging our intellectual property, or IP. Such license and development arrangements can further enhance the reach of our technology. Sales and Marketing

Our worldwide sales and marketing strategy is key to achieving our objective of providing markets with our high-performance and efficient computing platforms and software. Our sales and marketing teams, located across our global markets, work closely with customers and various industry ecosystems through our partner network. Our partner network incorporates global, regional and specialized CSPs, OEMs, ODMs, ISVs, global system integrators, add-in board manufacturers, or AIBs, distributors, automotive manufacturers and tier-1 automotive suppliers, and other ecosystem participants. Members of our sales team have technical expertise and product and industry knowledge. We also employ a team of application engineers and solution architects to provide pre-sales assistance to our partner network in designing, testing, and qualifying system designs that incorporate our platforms. For example, our solution architects work with CSPs to provide pre-sales assistance to enable our customers to optimize their hardware and software infrastructure for generative and agentic AI and LLM training and deployment. They also work with foundation model and enterprise software developers to enable our customers to optimize the training and fine-tuning of their models and services, and with enterprise end-users, often in collaboration with their global system integrator of choice, to fine-tune models and build AI applications. We believe that the depth and quality of our design support are key to improving our partner network’s time-to-market, maintaining a high level of customer satisfaction, and fostering relationships that encourage our customers and partner network to use the next generation of our products within each platform. To encourage the development of applications optimized for our platforms and software, we seek to establish and maintain strong relationships in the software development community. Engineering and marketing personnel engage with key software developers to promote and discuss our platforms, as well as to ascertain individual product requirements and solve technical problems. Our developer program supports the development of AI frameworks, SDKs, and APIs for software applications and game titles that are optimized for our platforms. Our Deep Learning Institute provides in-person and online training for developers in industries and organizations around the world to build AI and accelerated computing applications that leverage our platforms. Seasonality

Our computing platforms serve a diverse set of markets such as data centers, gaming, professional visualization, and automotive. Our desktop gaming products typically see stronger revenue in the second half of our fiscal year.

records.query: 微軟的雲端服務最近成長得快不快？
records.answer:
微軟的雲端服務近期增長非常快速，例如最近一個季度的 Microsoft Cloud 收入增長了 29%[MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #49]。  

具體來看：  
- Microsoft Cloud 收入在 2026 財政年度第三季（截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日）比去年同期增長 29%，達到 545 億美元（$54.5 billion）[MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #49]。  
- 同期的 Intelligent Cloud（智慧雲端）部門收入增加 79億美元或 30%[MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #69]，其中 Azure 和其他雲端服務收入增長 40%[MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #69]，也在第九個月報告中再次顯示增長 40%[MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #75]。  
- 在較長的九個月期間（截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日），Intelligent Cloud 收入增加 221億美元或 29%[MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #75]，伺服器產品與雲端服務收入增加 218億美元或 31%，同樣受 Azure 拉動[MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #75]。  
- 整體營收方面，微軟九個月營收因雲端服務增長而上升 365億美元或 18%[MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #65]，且三個月總營收也因 Microsoft Cloud 成長而增加 128億美元或 18%[MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #62]。  
- 此外，商業剩餘履約義務（Commercial remaining performance obligation）增長 99% 至 6,270 億美元（$627 billion），顯示未來雲端訂單強勁[MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #49]。  

以上數據均顯示微軟的雲端服務在最近一個季度及較長期間均保持高速增長。[所有引用均來自 MSFT_10Q_202603.html 的對應 chunk]。

Alphabet（GOOGL）的最近十二個月（TTM）淨利最高，為 1,602.1 億美元（$160.21 billion），其最近一年的營收年增率為 21.80%【GOOGL_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #0】。【GOOGL_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #0】同時顯示該公司的營收年增率（YoY）為 21.80%。相較之下，Microsoft 的 TTM 淨利為 1,252.2 億美元（$125.22 billion），營收年增率 18.30%【MSFT_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #0】；Amazon 的 TTM 淨利為 908 億美元（$90.80 billion），營收年增率 16.60%【AMZN_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #0】。因此，淨利最高且對應營收年增率的公司是 Alphabet（GOOGL）。

(1)    Regions represent Europe, the Middle East, and Africa (EMEA); Asia-Pacific (APAC); and Canada and Latin America ("Other Americas"). Revenue Backlog

As of June 30, 2026, we had $519.5 billion of remaining performance obligations (“revenue backlog”), of which $513.9 billion related to Google Cloud. Revenue backlog represents commitments in customer contracts that have not yet been recognized as revenue. We expect to recognize just over 50% of the revenue backlog as revenues over the next 24 months with the remainder to be recognized thereafter. The estimated revenue backlog and timing of revenue recognition for these commitments is largely driven by contract duration, our ability to deliver in accordance with relevant contract terms, and when our customers utilize services. Revenue backlog includes related deferred revenue currently recorded as well as amounts that will be invoiced in future periods and excludes cancellable contracts and payments we make to our customers not expected to be in exchange for distinct goods and services. In the first quarter of 2026, we elected to change our reporting of revenue backlog to also include contracts with an original expected term of one year or less. Deferred Revenues

We record deferred revenues when cash payments are received or due in advance of our performance, including amounts which are refundable. Deferred revenues primarily relate to Google Cloud and Google subscriptions, platforms, and devices. Total deferred revenue as of December 31, 2025 was $8.6 billion, of which $4.9 billion was recognized as revenues for the six months ended June 30, 2026.
